# At the core of what works

Get to know Lhoist

Get to know Lhoist

## At Lhoist, we provide lime, dolime, and mineral-based solutions that drive progress worldwide.

We partner with our customers and we deliver critical solutions across various [industries][5]. From
treating [drinking water][6] and [stabilizing soils][7] to [reducing emissions][8] and supporting
demanding industrial processes, our [products][9] support demanding operations that must perform
consistently.  

[
Learn more about us
][10]
[Expert in action_one man with a screen]

## Partner with Lhoist

We combine deep operational [expertise][11] with dependable, high‑performing solutions that perform
where it matters - in the real‑world conditions our customers face every day. Our products are
engineered to meet the specific demands of critical operations and applications. Beyond supply, we
also provide hands‑on [technical support][12] and reliable logistics services to help optimize
performance and efficiency.

[
Explore our solutions
][13]

## Learn more about the industries we support

[Expert at work _US]

## Join Lhoist to create lasting impact

At Lhoist, you [join teams][14] who take responsibility for keeping critical operations running, day
after day. Across our many roles, you will have the opportunity to grow your skills, solve real
challenges on the ground, and contribute to solutions that support industries and communities over
the long term. Step in and help build the reliability our future depends on.

At the core of what works.  

## Who we are

Our [lime][17], [dolime][18], and mineral solutions enable clean [water][19], stable soils,
[steel][20] under pressure, and renewable energy - where reliability matters every single day. 
Founded in 1889 and still family-owned, we combine long-term vision with hands-on expertise to meet
evolving needs. 
With 6,400+ people across 20+ countries, 130+ sites, and 80+ country sales reach, we stay close to
customers to secure supply and ensure continuity when it counts. 
Guided by respect, integrity, and courage, we work on site with operators, anticipating issues,
adapting to conditions, and creating lasting value through strong partnerships. Our teams deliver
the insight and support that keep performance steady and consistently.
